reviews.text: We went for a dermatological examination! An extremely thorough examination was performed, which was long overdue, unfortunately we have already visited many places with our problem! Infinite kindness and patience! Zserbóka has finally started on the path to recovery, thank you!🥰🩷🤍 …

We go to Dr. Vivien for our cat Bubi's skin problems. The Doctor is very thorough, kind, and patiently answered my many questions every time. It was great when she asked about the cat's condition by email between two consultations, and she answered any questions that arose later within a few days. I am extremely satisfied with her, I recommend her wholeheartedly :)
Everything was perfect, they were very helpful and kind :)

I am extremely satisfied with the work of Dr. Norbert Schuster. He is an extremely conscientious, attentive and dedicated veterinarian who clearly puts his heart and soul into his profession. He treats animals with great care and patience, which is particularly reassuring as an owner.

I would like to thank him again for his conscientious work, his expertise and the care with which he helps every time. I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone looking for a reliable and dedicated veterinarian!
They always do everything for our cats.

My opinion remains the same, they called in at a pre-arranged time, Veterinarians with outstanding professional experience and knowledge - we have been coming here for 10 years - take care of the animals taken there.
Our cat Rozi no longer licks her belly as much since/after the treatment, her condition has improved, but she needs to pay attention to her diet for the rest of her life.

They are being deported and are being diagnosed with rabies. I will explain to the non-believers

Answer to the doctor: the list is long… not only this. No need to explain. I didn't report it until now because I thought that if I had already left more than a million, then I would get a prescription for intestinal worms without paying the cat's special worming and consultation fee. How much money do you want to pay for it? I also found 2 other doctors who give deworming without paying a consultation fee. They also looked at why there was a consultation for this. And if you were to lie at least sensibly, that you can only give it out after a fecal test. But you look at people as so stupid, don't be surprised by my tone. The answer below is misleading. It wasn't about me not going in person. I clearly knew that I had to physically take it. As for the serious diagnostics, what happened when you told me that the cat was diabetic, and then you didn't check the fructoseamine without taking the blood because you can't do that at home with your serious diagnostic tools? Then I had to have the blood taken out of the hazardous waste bin so that you could send it to an external lab at the end of the day, and it turned out that the fructosamine level was average. But you wouldn't have checked it anyway. You think that stupid owner knows what it means and what it refers to. But obviously I'm most angry because you had all the cat's teeth pulled, when the problem wasn't serious. And it's always the same inflamed, in return for 4000 kcal of food a day, because it doesn't eat anything and just licks everything. You also ruined the cat's life, and it's a daily torment for me to chew all the food. And its mouth is still inflamed...

I have known Dr. Norbert Suszter for a long time, as he previously cared for my son's little parrot during his illness. Then and now, he treats small animals with great expertise and kindness, and he also has experience with parrots. The clinic is well-equipped, the environment is friendly. The software available for registration and information is of high quality and easy to use.

We received professional, precise, very high-quality care. I'm glad we finally found a place where they pay attention to everything. I highly recommend the clinic to anyone who cares about their pet's health :)

The clinic already knows my pet and he was also listed on the Facebook page as a frequent guest. Compared to smaller clinics, it is very well equipped and has two handlers. Online booking is great, no need to call. The team of specialists is also familiar, which is a big advantage, because they remember the patient's history and coordinate among themselves if necessary. I have to see specialists in certain cases, but between the two check-ups I always bring the cat here and they work perfectly with the specialists.
I can only say the best about them. A cultured, clean environment! Knowledgeable, kind professionals. They schedule appointments on time.
The care is professional, the staff here are kind and attentive.
Unfortunately, I don't have personal experience, but those who have helped me so far have only said good things about the attitude of the doctors and assistants, and the treatment of the animals.
Professional, knowledgeable, kind. I haven't had a bad experience here yet :)
They are kind, and my dog ​​always receives maximum care.

They are still the best!
Smiling, polite, patient and expert, conscientious,
PROFESSIONAL team. Thank you very much for your help, all "funky" with the kitties, Bella and Oszkár send their regards 🙂

My experiences have been good, taking care of my uncooperative dog was no problem, they also treated my cat with love. The booking system is good, you really don't have to wait - or hardly at all. There is also dental care on site, which is also very good.
The doctors were kind, they informed us about everything, the dog "became friendly". We were informed about the rest. We were completely satisfied with everything. Thank you

I was extremely satisfied. The doctor and the assistant were both very kind and patient. I was with a bunny, the animals loved him, I didn't even notice when he got the vaccine. Everything was explained to me thoroughly. I will only take our bunny here from now on!
They are kind, patient, and always answer all my questions. I have been coming here with my cat for years.

The clinic keeps the scheduled appointment time very precisely. This is a great relief for both the animals and the owners. We are new patients, but we immediately developed the kind of connection with Dr. Anna Sáfár that is needed for the owner to trust her with the apple of their eye. Everyone at the clinic is very nice. We have been to them 3 times so far. The care has always been professional. I am calm that my 12-year-old dog is in the right hands. I would like to highlight the correct and thorough information. I missed this in previous clinics. A worried owner has a question, which we always get an answer to here. I recommend this place to everyone for whom the same aspects are important.

We have been going to this clinic for 15 years. Extremely attentive, expert doctors who treat pets as if they were their own. Friendly assistants, quick online appointment booking option. The best💙🐶 …
We went on time, the call was accurate and the care was perfect.

We went to see Dr. Anna Sáfár with my puppy, I took him for vaccinations. He was very scared and trembling in the waiting room, but as soon as the doctor started examining him (because in addition to vaccinations, it was automatic for her to also check his teeth) and talking to him, his fear completely disappeared! 😊👍. We have been going here for a year (with the guinea pigs too). We have only had positive experiences! 😊👍
They are kind and attentive. I can only recommend them.
Dr. Gábor Miklós' expertise is up-to-date, his approach is complex, patient, kind, and he also has a sense of humor.

Very expensive place to take your pet!
I have paid 80,000 forint and the medication did not even work. A lot of money paid but the treatment and medicine they gave did not make a change, my dog still itching..
We went to district vet and it was way better
We have been coming here for 12 years with my dog ​​Mogyi.
A very kind doctor thoroughly examined my dog, gave her the vaccinations, and we discussed what to do next.
Reliable professionals, well-equipped clinic, helpful customer service
Kind employees who gave us lots of tips and examined my dog ​​very thoroughly even though we only came for one vaccination. We will definitely be back.

I took my 8-year-old Rhodesian Ridgeback dog to the clinic for a pre-anesthesia and general screening test due to tartar removal. We had previously agreed by phone that a complete blood test, heart and abdominal ultrasound would be performed, and we were given an appointment accordingly.

Assistant D. on site said that he would then take the dog for the tests without me, which I did not agree with, so I was allowed to go in too. The doctor who took the blood did not introduce himself, did not say a word, and started taking the blood. When I saw that they were only taking one vial, I asked if this would be enough for a complete blood test, to which Assistant D. replied that they usually do a complete blood test only when it is justified. I had to indicate that this had been agreed in advance, and that is how I got the appointment. After that, another vial of blood was taken. When the doctor handed it over to assistant K., blood spurted out of the first vial, to which assistant K. indicated that this would not be good, the lab did not usually accept such a sample. To this, the doctor replied that “it will be fine this way”. Then we placed the dog on the narrow examination table, I guided what was expected of him, he lay down and calmly endured the ultrasound in my presence. (If they had wanted to perform these examinations on a Ridgeback without me, they would have taken a serious risk that the dog would break out, and it could easily have caused an accident and damage)

During the ultrasound, assistant D. commented on my dog’s weight. Anyone who knows the breed knows that when it is lying on its side, its extremely wide rib cage spreads out, which is why he could have judged it as heavy, but he entered into a give-and-take dialogue. (The dog's weight, breed, height, age, ideal)

The communication and reactions of the doctor performing the ultrasound were, to put it mildly, nonexistent.

The doctor performing the dental examination did not introduce himself, but sat with his back to me and started by saying that the doctor performing the ultrasound said that I also requested a thyroid screening and indicated how much the tests so far cost and whether I definitely wanted the THS screening, which involves additional costs. I explained again what kind of examination I had brought the dog for and that I would expect a consultation, to inform me what an 8-year-old dog should be screened for in the framework of the requested examination. I do not think that a THS screening was necessary, so I did not ask for it.
Nevertheless, when the head of the practice explained the lab results over the phone, the THS was also included….

Overall, I experienced serious communication problems and a condescending style at this practice, which created complete distrust in me, so I had the dental procedure performed by another veterinarian.
Thank you for the excellent review :)
Very kind doctors, understanding. We have a hamster, we received a very detailed explanation of what the problem was.
It's clear that they love animals and have compassion for their owners, and their expertise is also evident 🥰 …

They are professional and usually available with only a short waiting time. They’re a bit pricey, but I feel the quality of care is well worth the cost. More importantly, they’ve always helped keep my cats healthy, and I’ve never had to come back multiple times for the same issue—just the treatment that was needed.
A sense of security, maximum attention, care and extremely kind people. Thank you very much 😁 …
We received very kind and careful care. Thank you very much!

I visited the clinic for the first time, with a Forlos kitten, I was completely satisfied with the process, the staff, the assistants, I thank the doctor Dr. Kata Annus for her work, she did a fair and nice job, my kitten is healing, she didn't pull out any teeth unnecessarily, she informed me about everything, unfortunately only by phone, I missed the personal meeting, so I only saw the doctor briefly. In terms of the price, I also think that this service costs this much, whoever wants to give their kitten to professional hands, to have their mouth and teeth treated/removed with x-rays and in a professional manner under proper anesthesia, should be prepared for this, it is not cheap, but whoever cares about their pet should take this on board. I recommend the clinic, we will also go here for check-ups.
I can absolutely recommend the clinic. We have been going to the clinic with 7 cats for years and they have been very conscientious in taking care of them every time.

Since the closure of our previous veterinary practice, we have been wandering between different places, but we have not found trust anywhere. We just visited the Zugló Veterinary Clinic for the first time, and our first impression was positive! We had a very kind, helpful and extremely thorough examination. Dr. Vivien Albrecht and her colleagues have won our trust with both their professional preparation and their humane attitude.
Everything went perfectly fine. Ziva was vaccinated, the doctor examined her thoroughly, and had some suggestions regarding her weight😊 …
I made an appointment for my cat on Saturday morning due to a nighttime illness. We were greeted kindly and attentively, Dr. Noémi Kubik answered all our questions and examined the cat thoroughly.
Even though it's a doctor's office, it's a pleasure to come here.

I wholeheartedly recommend the medical staff, if I hadn't found the clinic, my cat would definitely not be alive. They did everything they could to make sure that my cat Mézi would recover and they are still monitoring her condition, but she is doing great now, thank God! My faith and trust in the doctors and staff working at this Zugló Veterinary Clinic took root here! They are kind, smiling, patient! I am grateful to everyone!
Very professional and deeply kind staff. Thank you for the care
Cleanliness and order greeted us. The doctor and the assistants were kind and patient with Gizi and us. Thank you.
Very good first impression, polite, patient, animal friendly team, we will go again

So far I was completely satisfied, but today I had to wait 35 minutes for my medicine purchase, which took NOT TWO minutes! I had an appointment for 11:15, the “nice” assistant lady even deigned to come out at 11:50 (she would have had plenty of time much earlier!) to ask what I wanted… This has never happened here before, so far they have at least respected those with appointments enough to pay attention to their appointments.
Lovely cute place and our doctor was very thorough and conscientious.

We came here because of our cat's ears, as they were both quite runny and he was scratching regularly. They examined and looked at both ears, but they couldn't see down to his eardrum. Only then did they clean them. In addition to the examination, they took a sample and sent it to the lab (so we had to pay the courier fee) and gave him an ear cleaning pad and an anti-inflammatory (which totaled about a 10). All of this cost 77 thousand, which I felt was a lot even then, especially given how uncertain the results were. Since they couldn't even tell me the condition of the eardrum, we went as far as a possible skull CT scan and ear canal removal. Incidentally, we started with an ear problem and ended up with a diagnosis of a broken tooth (However, as it turned out, he had just changed his baby tooth). Later, during the examination at another vet, they first cleaned and then examined the ears, so they were able to tell the exact condition of the ears right away. They also took samples there and gave ear cleaning solution and ear drops for home treatment. We paid a total of 29 thousand at this place and since then the ear problem has been resolved.
